title: fix(pm): the record reader closes a fence only on a bare run and opens its scope only on an unindented heading; the writer refuses on a key line and names the new causes

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D6oE9YXTxKNvir4NixYdUwr)_

domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czoR81DDKSnGWnBYqA

Fixes #28057

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：契约复核记录的 `Head-sha:` 读取器再收紧两处，写入侧的拒收更准、报错点名新原因。(1) 围栏代码只在「同字符、不短于开栏、整行只有符号」的一行上关闭；三个反引号后面跟了文字的行是围栏内容，不关栏。(2) `## Contract review` 题头缩进 4 个空格或 tab（渲染为代码块）不再打开读取范围，与 `Head-sha:` 行本身的 3 空格上限一致。(3) `post-stamped.mjs` 发帖前的 `Head-sha` 拒收改为只看「以该键开头的行」（任意缩进、引用、列表、粗体、反引号都算），不再因为正文句中提到 `Head-sha:` 就拒收。(4) 拒收文案与 `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS['Head-sha']` 点名两个新原因：代码缩进的行、引用或代码缩进题头之下的行。(5) `contract-review.md:33` 写明 `Head-sha:` 行在「题头之下」，行数不变、120 字节；`--template` 的说明同步。4 个文件。
- 为什么改：这是 PR #28042 delta 复核的 should-fix 4–8。两种残留写法在基线上同样会把引用或代码样式的行读成记录的 head；线上 713 条记录 0 例，属响亮度收尾。写入侧那条是误拒：引了题头、句中提到键名的普通评论被拒。无新门禁、无新拒收类。
- 风险与回滚：读取只收紧不放宽；写入侧拒收集缩到「有键行」，#28042 钉住的每种拒收写法仍拒。实测 2026-10-23 以来 11482 条评论、724 条带题头记录：新旧读法逐条相同（0 变），拒收逐条相同（0 变）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`check-half-states.mjs` 的 `FENCE_CLOSE_LINE` 与 `contractReviewHeadSha` 的两行改动；再看 `post-stamped.mjs` 的 `HEAD_SHA_KEY_LINE`。
- 两分钟验证：本 head 五个自测全部 exit 0：half-states 5113、recognisers 337、post-stamped 747、owed-reviews 65、guard 403；四条消融各恰红一条新钉。
- 需要你做的：无。本 PR 欠一次契约复审（席位安排）；落地档以登记册为准（`.claude/**` ×1，本地 `--test` 读为 Tier S）。

## What changes

- **`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`.** `FENCE_CLOSE_LINE` (new, module-private) admits only whitespace after the run; `contractReviewHeadSha` now opens a fence on `FENCE_LINE` (info string allowed) and closes it only on a `FENCE_CLOSE_LINE` of the same character with a run at least the opening length. The heading scope opens only when the marker line also matches `^[ ]{0,3}#` (no blockquote marker, no four-space or tab indent); `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER` itself is unchanged, so the locator, H43, owed-reviews, the guard and `recordKeyedLineRefusals` still see an indented or quoted heading as a record. Two pins in the H51 block: the trailing-text close (open stays open; a later bare run closes; trailing whitespace closes) and the indented heading (four spaces and a tab open nothing, three spaces does, the marker still finds it, `latestContractReviewOnHead` answers null).
- **`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`.** `HEAD_SHA_KEY_ANYWHERE` becomes `HEAD_SHA_KEY_LINE`: a line opening on the key after any indent, blockquote markers, a `-`/`*`/`+` bullet or a list number, bold or backticks, case-blind, `m` flag. Every refused shape the #28042 battery pins still reads as a key line; a mid-sentence mention does not. The refusal `why` and `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS['Head-sha']` name the code-indented line and the line under a quoted or code-indented heading. Three pins: the prose mention is untouched, decorated key lines (numbered, doubly quoted, `+`-bulleted, under a code-indented heading) are refused, the printed text names both causes.
- **`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`.** The `--template` note for `Head-sha` says the line is plain and BELOW the heading, and lists the shapes that read as prose. One line added to the printed template help; no reader touched.
- **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`** (:33, line-neutral, 120 bytes): 「题头之下 `Head-sha:` 行独占码段」.

## Why

The delta contract review of PR #28042 (record 6520969324) left should-fixes 4 to 8, filed as #28057 and triaged p3 (6522257381: loudness, no wrong head admitted). Measured on `origin/main` `549203d04` before the change:

1. `FENCE_LINE` matched a closing run with trailing text, so after ```` ``` ```` + ```` ``` not a close ```` the fence was read as closed and a `Head-sha:` line after it was read. CommonMark keeps the fence open. Same on base.
2. The scope opened on `    ## Contract review` (an indented code block to the renderer) while the key line is held to three spaces. Same on base; 0 live instances.
3. `HEAD_SHA_KEY_ANYWHERE` matched the key anywhere, so a record-shaped comment that quotes a heading at line start and names `Head-sha:` mid-sentence was refused with "a `Head-sha` key is present". Loudness only.
4. The refusal text and the spelling enumerated "blockquoted, bulleted, fenced or pre-heading" and not the two causes #28042 added.
5. `contract-review.md:33` named the line but not that it sits below the heading; the `--template` note said "on THIS line" only.

No new refusal class and no new gate: the accept set of every reader is the same or narrower than base, and the write-time refusal fires on a strict subset of what it fired on before (a key LINE rather than the key anywhere).

## Verification

- Self-tests on the committed head, exit captured before any pipe: `check-half-states --self-test` 0 (5113 cases), `record-recognisers --self-test` 0 (337), `post-stamped --self-test` 0 (747 across 26 batteries), `check-owed-reviews --self-test` 0 (65 in 9 batteries), `check-governed-queue-guard --self-test` 0 (403).
- Ablation on the committed head, each leg restored with `git checkout` and `git status --porcelain` empty: (A) `FENCE_CLOSE_LINE` back to the bare `FENCE_LINE` shape: half-states 1 of 5113 red (the trailing-text pin), recognisers 0, post-stamped 0. (B) the scope-open test back to `!/^\s*>/`: half-states 1 red (the indented-heading pin), post-stamped 1 of 747 (the code-indented-heading limb). (C) `HEAD_SHA_KEY_LINE` back to `/head-sha[ \t`*]*:/i`: post-stamped 1 red (the mid-sentence pin). (D) the two new causes removed from the `why` and the spelling: post-stamped 1 red (the wording pin). No other pin moves in any leg.
- Corpus: 11482 issue comments updated since 2026-10-23 (REST, 115 pages), 724 carrying the heading marker, driven through `contractReviewHeadSha` and `recordKeyedLineRefusals` in a worktree at this head and one at `origin/main` `6b125a7a`: 0 records read differently, 0 records refused differently, 0 differences in the refusal over all 11482 comments; the 2 nulls are the two no-key legacy records, the 1 refusal on both sides is the pre-existing `Local-runs` row on record 6517315440.
- Skill text: `check-skill-line-ratchet` exit 0 (contract-review.md 60 lines, ceiling 60; line 33 is 120 bytes under `MAX_LINE_BYTES` 120), `check-skill-id-lint` exit 0 (105 files clean), `check-skills-token-ratchet` exit 0 (56 files within ceilings).
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` at the committed head `f619d317` derives 56 families; all 56 run in a second worktree (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` first), exit codes recorded; `--ran` reconciles 56 derived / 56 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED / 0 UNRUN. One first-pass exit 3 (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, no formula/lint dist) exits 0 after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`. No family red. No changeset derived: no published package is touched, `skip-changeset` rides the create.
- Landing tier: `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the four paths answers Tier S (`.claude/**` ×1; the three `scripts/pm/**` paths are off the register); the register's reading at PR time is the seat's.
